summary: Source Data remembers previously used SQL Server server and database names, and pins Import Data to the bottom of the window.
details: Server and database names that connect successfully are saved on the ArcRho Server, so everyone using it can pick them again from a dropdown instead of retyping.
Each saved entry has a remove action in the dropdown: removing a database drops that server/database pair, removing a server drops all of its pairs.
The database dropdown only lists databases recorded for the server currently entered.
Only names and a last-used time are saved; no credentials are stored.
Import Data now stays at the bottom edge of the Import Settings window at any size, and the corner resize grip icon was removed while drag-to-resize still works.
